original: Tsiligirides T. Heuristic Methods Applied to Orienteering. JORS 35(9),797–809 (1984).
conversion: All 19 tasks, unmodified coordinates/rewards. Coordinates interpreted as meters. Original 30-unit travel budget is NOT converted mathematically: new 30-second flight budget chosen for acceleration-aware experiments. Axis speed 3m/s, acceleration 1.5m/s²; zero endpoint velocities. No obstacles, collisions, or communication. Published OP optimal values do not apply.
license: Primary download has no explicit license notice. Preserve attribution; no new license asserted for original benchmark data.
